title: dryopteris truncata
intro: Dryopteris truncata, commonly known as the Scaly Male Fern or Autumn Fern, is a species of fern native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris truncata include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate pain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
